text:
Based on the onboarding documentation, the issue is caused by an incorrect endpoint URL:

* Your error log shows the request is hitting **`https://ollama.com/api`**, which returns a `404 Not Found`.
* Hermes Agent's built-in **`ollama-cloud`** provider expects routing to **`https://ollama.com/v1`**.

### How to Fix:
Ensure your configuration uses the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider settings with the base URL set to `https://ollama.com/v1` (rather than `/api`). You can reconfigure this via `hermes setup` or by updating your `~/.hermes/config.yaml` to point to `https://ollama.com/v1`.
